notes.title: Hot & Fresh: Pizza Fever in Peyter Town! 🍕
notes.content:
🍕 IT'S PIZZA O'CLOCK IN DELIVOO! 🍕

Restaurant Additions
I’ve cooked up something special – 20 NEW PIZZAS are making their way to Peyter Town! From cheesy classics to spicy specials, you are going to have a blast delivering them all while they're hot!

Feature Development

 Restaurants now have a placeholder for the orders that are being prepared at the moment and a separate one for the orders that are ready to be picked up.
 If an order waits to be picked up for more than x (where x is determined by how patient the customer is and/or when the restaurant closes for the day), it automatically expires and you get a bad rating.
 If your backpack is full, you can now cancel active orders and free up your backpack (and lose money and rating points, including any bonus streaks or tiers you have activated in the app).


Cleanup

 Added more lights in the streets of Peyter Town City Center
 Cleaned up repetitive restaurant buildings
 Fixed the broken elevator logic where you would be elevated to floors that did not exist in that building


Steam Next Fest 2025
I'm also gearing up for Steam Next Fest in June 2025! Be the first to try exclusive demos, interact with me live, and get behind-the-scenes insights on Delivoo.

Want to help shape Peyter Town? Join our Discord Community to vote on upcoming features, participate in giveaways, and chat with other delivery enthusiasts. We’d love to hear your thoughts!

Do you want to help me? 
The single most important thing is for you to share your feedback on Discord and, if you like the idea of the game, wishlist it on Steam and share it with your friends and family!

Thank you from all my heart!

notes.title: January 2025 updates 🍣
notes.content:
Happy 2025 🍭

There have been so many changes in the past 2 years of working on Delivoo for me and my family! We've had an amazing year in 2024 and I feel like some of that authentic spirit will also be visible in-game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191333/a70001577eeae689227a5103a785843a97b53f14.png

I wish all of you (wishlisters and readers) an awesome 2025! I hope you and your families are blessed with happiness and joy!

Steam Next Fest June 2025 🌯

Happily, I have enrolled Delivoo to Steam's Next Fest in June of this year. This means I'd have to publish a playable version by May and the current deadline for this playable version is April 🍱. 

I'm keen to complete this development phase that will include most of the entire gameplay mechanics, but limited map size and variation and publish it for you to provide feedback on it 🍟.

Updates from Developer's desk
This last quarter of 2024 I have been busy with putting final touches on restaurant pickup, inventory system, temperature system and phone look&feel and I'm pretty happy with the results.

These final 3 months of effort are fully dedicated to completing the following aspects of the game:

 Vehicles 🚕 🚙  🚎 🚚 & public transportation
 Multiple restaurant menus (I want to have at least 35 by early access 🥦
 Player home & farming (only apartment for now, house / mansion and outdoor garden will come at a later point).
 AI for people around the town.
 One map area fully developed and designed.
 Performance tweaks and compatibility with all operating systems and Steam Deck.


Thank you
Thank you for an awesome 2024 and looking forward to releasing early access of the game this year! Remember, wishlisting the game provides the best sort of support to me!

notes.title: 🍂 Fall Update 2024 🍂
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I've got some exciting news to share about the latest progress on Delivoo 🚚🌆. The game has been evolving rapidly, and I'm thrilled to announce some major improvements and fresh content!

🔧 Redesigned Architecture
Our team has been hard at work behind the scenes, rebuilding Delivoo’s core architecture from the ground up 🛠️. This overhaul means faster performance, smoother gameplay, and a more immersive experience overall. I've taken your feedback to heart and optimized everything to make sure the game runs like a well-oiled machine! 🚀.

With this change, support for latest Unity SDK has been deeply integrated into Delivoo's save / load system, state management and timers (yes, there are a lot of timers involved in an ordering app).

🎨 New Art Additions
I've added stunning new pixel art to the game! 🌟 From vibrant urban landscapes to detailed character sprites, every corner of Delivoo has received a visual glow-up ✨. I've added new environments, more diverse NPCs, and a lot of small details that really bring the world to life. I can’t wait for you to explore these new areas! 🎮

Together with the art I've put my hands on, there are now 5 different districts of Peyter Town, with a planned number of 8, ranging from busy city center where the stadium, cinema and shopping mall is, to the serene countryside where farmers collect their autumn goods.

🍁 As the season changes, I'm also incorporating some seasonal touches to celebrate Fall! Keep an eye out for cozy autumn vibes throughout the city, with colorful leaves and decorations, once the game releases 🌳🍂.

I will be posting new screenshots to the Steam page, so stay tuned for that.

As always, thank you, from the bottom of my heart(h) for the stunning number of wishlists. I wish you and your families enjoy the cozy and warm Autumn vibes and remember to smile now and again.

notes.title: 🍹 Summer Update! 🍹
notes.content:
Hey dear friends!

I hope you're all enjoying the summer vibes! I've got some exciting news to share, so grab a cold drink, sit back, and let’s dive into the latest and greatest happening in the world of Delivoo.

 🚗 What's New in Delivoo? 
First off, I'm thrilled to announce that development continued all this time! I've been hard at work behind the scenes, and am excited to bring you some fresh content and features that are sure to make your delivery adventures even more fun:

 🌟 New Features: 

Dynamic Weather System: Now, rain, shine, or snow—every delivery will keep you on your toes! Adapt to changing conditions and keep your customers happy, no matter the weather.

New Delivery Challenges:  Introducing time-sensitive special deliveries with unique rewards! Can you beat the clock and earn those rare items?

Expanded City Map: I've created new neighborhoods! Explore more of the vibrant city, meet quirky new characters, and discover hidden secrets around every corner.


🎨 Visual Upgrades: 
Enhanced Pixel Art: I've given the game’s art a fresh polish! Expect brighter colors, smoother animations, and even more charm in every pixel.


🚀 What's Coming Next?
My journey with Delivoo is just getting started, and I have even bigger plans on the horizon! 

Me and my family will take a vacation and, once back, I will post more updates with how the game is coming along.

As always, thank you very much for the wishlists and  they are the best way to support the game development . So, if you haven't done so already,  wishlist asap .

Enjoy your vacations!

notes.title: Amazing plans ahead
notes.content:
Still staying strong ːsteamthisː in 2023

First, I'd like to thank the people that wishlisted Delivoo in these past 6 months. It's been a rollercoaster of motivation and drive for me, as the solo developer of the game, but each time I logged into Steam to check the stats, my heart raced for every new increment of the wishlist count.

Second, I am thankful for those of you who reached out, visited the website and the YouTube channel. The video got 1.5k views and one lovingly comment, which I simply adore. As someone that thought game development is pretty easy, it turns out the problem was not technical, but rather motivational, as it requires more creativity than technical expertise (as opposed to software development).

Third, the reason why these first 5 months of 2023 were a bit silent was partly due to the fact that me and my family are building a house and partly due to me failing my promise of updating you weekly - which, in retrospect, is unrealistic given the workload and the fact that I am a single guy generating all this content - from graphics and mechanics in the game, to items, locations, quests, NPCs and dialogue, story, achievements and performance - writing updates on Steam and getting the graphics for them tops it all up and makes the glass overflow. 

What will happen from now on

I'll hold back with my promises to you as I feel like I cheat you when overestimating my ability to generate all this content. I will post updates on Steam whenever I get the time for it and I feel like there's something major to showcase, I'll upload new videos on YouTube as soon as I get some part of the game fully polished and I'll post regular updates on the game's facebook page and Patreon.

I have a concise plan of schedule in terms of development aims and I'll do all I can to stick to it. By current estimates, you'll see major feature development (and corresponding updates) every 1 / 1.5 months, especially since the scope grew quite a bit lately with even more mechanics and things to do in-game.

As usual, I hope you'll stick around to see the finished product: a heartfelt game about a delivery driver grinding in order to open their own Restaurant, learning recipes, going through all possible scenarios and buying himself a ranch to raise his own organic crops (sneak - peak right there).

I appreciate all the support you've shown and I'll keep you updated at every step of the way.

You can support my work at this game using the following links:

  Facebook Page 



Thank you
As always, I'd like to thank you for your support and feedback - bringing joy in your homes and hearts is my objective and I'll do what I can to bring that drop of laughter and that pill of heartwarming atmosphere in your day to day routine.

'Till next time!

notes.title: [Weekly Dev Update] - #5 End of 2022
notes.content:
Dev Update - (multiple weeks) #5
Planning

These past few weeks (with Holidays included) I've worked on putting together a definitive plan for 2023 - including releasing the game.

Sprints & Agile

I've decided to work in sprints of 1 week - I have about 85 tasks to complete in the coming months and hope to release an early access version of the game sometime this summer.

There's still a massive amount of content to be added, but I'm glad to announce that the main mechanics are already put in place and working in isolation.

Markets, Outskirts, Buildings

I've designed grocery stores and markets where you can shop for products to fill your customers' baskets and deliver them in time, along with food and other types of orders from restaurants and other theme stores.

I've also designed 6 outskirt areas populated by houses where you will have long distance orders. You need to plan your route according to traffic, weather conditions, special events and more.

I've also designed 5 new types of buildings (blocks of flats, skyscrapers, restaurants, markets and car shops) and implemented the inside navigation inside.

AI Improvements

I have made some improvements to how NPCs drive their cars around and prepared the stage for events such as football and sports matches, visits from important people (celebrities, politicians, influencers) and car shows.

notes.title: [Weekly Dev Update] - #4 Framework

Dev Update - Week #4
The week of refinements

This week, the focus was mainly on making sure the game has a strong framework to support the features I plan.

Redesigned order management

Order generation and the entire flow used to be messy - I have improved and cleaned it of weird random logic blocks and it now allows for easier configuration.

You will now receive orders based on your skills and level, so that you won't get to deliver a 15 km order on foot, during winter time.

Character customisation

It is important for your character to closely represent your personality - that's why you now have around 2500 combinations of bodies, eye colours, hairstyles and hair colours to choose from.

I also started to lay the bricks for purchasing accessories and outfits around Peytor Town.

notes.title: [Weekly Dev Update] - #2 Home & Cars
notes.content:
Dev Update - Week #2
The week of home design

This week I've worked on giving you a place to call "home". You start in a tiny and cozy apartment in the South District where you have the essential items: a bed, a small kitchen and a drawer with clothes thrown around.

Also, I've started to work on driving mechanics. You can hop in your car and drive around Peytor Town, albeit it's a very alpha version of the final design and function.

Heartwarming lightning
https://media.giphy.com/media/Z0HWBAm36T0P2ohHs0/giphy.gif

Since the whole point of a home is to create a cozy atmosphere, I thought the natural light coming from the two windows would aid in that process. Here is how the lightning changes during the day-night cycle. Hope you like the colours!

You can also use the bed in your apartment to sleep and regain energy (while skipping time). Don't sleep too much or you'll miss the bonus orders of early morning.

You can also choose to sleep during the day and only deliver orders at nighttime, thus minimising the time spent in traffic and maximising profits ːsteamhappyː

Driving the car
https://media.giphy.com/media/DD5pnZZQv7wq6Q4Mop/giphy.gif

After you purchase (or rent) a car from one of multiple dealers around Peytor town, you'll be able to use it to deliver long-distance orders more quickly than on foot. 

Keep in mind that owning a car is different from renting a car:
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Type[/th]
        [th]Fuel costs[/th]
        [th]Insurance[/th]
        [th]Parking[/th]
        [th]Repairs costs[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Renting[/td]
        [td]You get the car with tank / battery full [/td]
        [td] You pay higher insurance costs[/td]
        [td] You get an unlimited parking subscription all around Peytor Town [/td]
        [td] Fully covered by insurance [/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Owning[/td]
        [td] You pay for the gas / electricity you use [/td]
        [td]You pay lower insurance costs[/td]
        [td]You pay for each individual parking meter or purchase area subscriptions[/td]
        [td]You pay for any damages to the vehicle[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

Types of cars
The plan is to have both electric and gas engine cars in multiple colours. Here is a preliminary list:


 Gasoline / electric small car (easy parking, lower insurance, better fuel economy, slower)
 Gasoline / electric sedan (higher insurance, more complicated parking, worse fuel economy, faster, gives you extra storage for orders, supports food heating/cooling gadgets)
 Gasoline / electric sports car (easy parking, highest insurance, worst fuel economy, fastest, coolest)
 Gasoline / electric van (gives you the most extra storage, supports most gadgets, can sleep in it, higher fuel capacity, gives you the ability to deliver parcels).

The week of Excitement

This week I launched the Steam page so there's that! I am really excited to having the game page up on Steam, as it allows me to easily communicate plans and progress with you.

Order delivered successfully

https://media.giphy.com/media/yzLrQzbb4WV44hqsXv/giphy.gif

I have added an animation for when you deliver an order to a customer. In case of success, you'll see the points earned (I'll tell you more about these points in a later weekly devlog) and the feedback that the customer left you (which can be either positive or negative and it can get really funny).

View order history

https://media.giphy.com/media/Hm1XrQpFmeCprcf1am/giphy.gif

You'll be able to see the order history in a nice elastic scrollable list in a dedicated app on your phone. This helps both showing off to your friends and finding out what's your total count of successful/unsuccessful orders.

New Wallet Design

https://media.giphy.com/media/h4k9lr1AYsh6CRG8T4/giphy.gif

That ugly green background for the wallet is now gone and the placement of banknotes and coins is now different (I will update the screenshots from the game page as well at some point).
